about.intro: Hey there, I'm Sven! Coding has always fascinated me. I love turning concepts based on UI/UX principles into working software. Freelance work for companies and startups keeps me improving.
about.location: I'm based in Plauen, Germany, and open to remote work or positions in my region.
about.learning: I recently deepened HTML and CSS and learned SCSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular, Supabase and Git. I keep learning.
about.approach: I start every challenge with an analysis of the current state and systematic debugging. Creativity helps me build simple, functional designs with great usability. As a former design team lead in e-commerce, I know the value of collaboration.
